title: Compliance Request Automation Playbook and Data Residency Configurator
creator: Ava Mitchell
description: Build an end-to-end Compliance Request Automation Playbook and a Data Residency Configurator to reduce manual work for Customer Success and Security teams when handling audit requests, DPA signing, and evidence exports. This ticket scopes the product spec, core API surfaces, console flows, and a minimal automation engine to assemble audit bundles from retention snapshots and questionnaire responses.
background: Customers are frequently asking for on-demand evidence (audit trail, DPA excerpts, data residency confirmations) and we currently respond with manual bundles and playbooks. That approach scales poorly for mid-market and enterprise. The goal is to automate the routine parts of intake: capturing tenant-level residency & retention settings, templated questionnaire handling, and one-click evidence exports with signed manifests.
goals: Provide a Data Residency Configurator in Console that lets admins set region residency constraints per-tenant and preview which datasets are affected
Expose retention controls (global and per-type like logs, KV cache, request traces) with human-readable retention explanations
Ship an Audit Bundle API that composes snapshots (config, policy, access logs, exported sample records) and DPA artifacts into a signed zip for customers
Create a Questionnaires workflow that stores responses, maps answers to evidence items, and can auto-fill common fields from tenant metadata
Reduce manual CS/legal time per compliance request by >=70% for standard requests (non-custom legal reviews)
acceptance_criteria: Console: Residency Configurator UI implemented with region selector, scope selector (models, logs, metrics), and change preview
Console: Retention settings UI supporting presets and per-dataset overrides with validation and confirmation modal
API: /v1/compliance/audit-bundles endpoint that returns a signed bundle and metadata manifest
Automation: Questionnaire templating engine that can map 80% of standard SOC/GDPR questions to platform artifacts
Docs: Playbook + Support KB for CS with scripted remediation steps and escalation paths
Security: Feature passes security checklist and design review (security_review_required=true)
tasks: PM: finalize canonical list of evidence artifacts and mapping table
Design: mock Data Residency Configurator and retention UX; high-fidelity flow for bundle export
Eng (API): implement audit-bundle composer service + signed manifest generation
Eng (Console): residency and retention UI components, preview diff, change audit trail
Eng (Infra): snapshot exporter for logs and example records (masking rules) and temporary staging storage
Docs/Support: author playbook, canned responses, and export checklist
Legal: review DPA excerpt template and approve automated bundling language
SRE: run load tests for bundle generation at scale and validate cost/latency constraints
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Exporting sample records may leak PII if masking is incomplete. Mitigation: require a validated masking policy and gated export role; include mandatory review step for >threshold exports.

Risk: Residency UI may give false assurances if downstream infra not aligned. Mitigation: add validation hooks to runtime routing/service catalog and show 'verification status' for each region mapping.
Risk: Heavy bundle generation load could impact serving nodes. Mitigation: schedule exports on dedicated workers and throttle per-tenant concurrency.
metrics: CS hours spent per request (target -70% vs baseline)
Number of manual follow-ups per request (target < 1 on average)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Beta): internal & select customers — limited to hosted tenants, manual approval toggle on exports
Phase 2: expand to Dedicated; add retention presets and automation rules
Phase 3: Private deployments — include on-prem snapshot adaptors and KMS export options
Opt-in / feature flag for early customers, measure feedback and iterate
notes_and_decisions: Decision: Start with a signed zip manifest approach (PKCS7-ish signature) for bundles rather than ad-hoc PDFs to simplify verification
Decision: Expose retention controls for three domains first: request logs, KV cache snapshots, and metrics/telemetry; leave model weights/checkout data for later
Tradeoff: Full automated legal review is out of scope for MVP; include legal templates and a handshake flow to capture custom approvals
